# Henry Xiao — Agent Builder & Data AI Engineer

## Identity
Name: Henry Xiao
Role: Data and AI Customer Success Engineer @ IBM Financial Services Market (FSM)

## About
Henry Xiao is a Data & AI Customer Success Engineer at IBM, focused on helping organizations adopt and accelerate Data & AI solutions — from modernizing data architectures to implementing Agentic AI capabilities that drive operational efficiency, strengthen risk management, and support regulatory compliance. His approach is modular, open architecture that bridges agentic innovation with engineering rigor.

## Areas of Expertise

### Agentic AI
Demystifying agentic AI for data engineers by bridging innovation with engineering rigor through modular, open architectures that preserve determinism, reproducibility, and control.
Skills: LangChain, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, IBM watsonx, IBM Bob

### Data Integration & Intelligence
Championing agentic data engineering as an execution model using MCP servers and AI orchestration across Batch ETL, real-time data streaming, Change Data Capture (CDC), and other integration modes.
Skills: Confluent Kafka, IBM DataStage, IBM watsonx.data integration, IBM watsonx.data intelligence

### Enterprise Governance
Positioning governed, explainable agentic workflows through human-in-the-loop approvals, guardrails, and standardized configurations that maintain engineering-friendly transparency.

### Customer Success & Enablement
Competitive analysis, business value articulation, client co-creation, and sales enablement.

## Projects

### FSM CSE IBM Bob Community Hub (2026) — IBM Internal
Enterprise AI enablement platform for FSM Data & AI Customer Success Engineers. Agentic Center of Excellence with 25+ integration patterns across 10+ IBM products. 40+ contributors.
Status: In Production

### CSE LLM Wiki (2026)
Specialized productivity tool for CSE teams. Custom IBM Bob mode/skill that helps CSEs track technology, client information, and contract details. Implements the LLM Wiki pattern popularized by Andrej Karpathy.
GitHub: https://github.com/Henry-Xiao-HX/CSE-LLM-WIKI
Status: Active

### Personal Chef Agent (2026)
Demo minimum configuration for AI agents built with Python and LangChain. Demonstrates conversation memory, context management, and practical agentic AI patterns.
GitHub: https://github.com/Henry-Xiao-HX/personal-chef-agent
Status: Demo
